__typename.description: GraphQL type name of this object.

value.description: The barcode in its standard form with its scheme, e.g. `gtin:09506682101352`. Matches the `barcode` of lines and stock lines.

barcode.description: The barcode as people read it, e.g. `9506682101352`

gtin.description: The barcode as people read it. Use `barcode`.

isAutoCreated.description: The barcode is on a variant central created only to hold barcodes

parentId.description: Barcodes no longer have a parent; always null. Kept so older clients that still ask for it keep working.
